depends_on.opcode_map.json: The rule is checked against the empirical map on load; any contradiction refuses to work.
depends_on.reference_headers_php52_candidate/zend_v: Native handler operand types used to guard a prediction.

format_variant: SSG Team serialized research v6 / encoder opcode position rule (byte base minus instruction index mod 8)
limitations: The rule adds predictions, not new native observations.
Only bytes present in the byte base table can be predicted.
A prediction whose operand shape does not fit the PHP 5.2 handler is refused.
The native semantics of a predicted opcode is not established by the rule itself.
own_probe_files: none; the position rule is derived from the empirical map, not from a native probe
status_policy: The rule contradicts the extended empirical map and is never used to decode.  It is kept as a research record of how the byte table of the map is built.
